arms.prompt: Chart the total revenue of each region using bars.
arms.program:
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Read the CSV file
df = pd.read_csv('/mnt/uploads/sales.csv')

# Group by 'region' and calculate the sum of 'revenue'
grouped_revenue = df.groupby('region')['revenue'].sum()

# Plot the grouped revenue
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
grouped_revenue.plot(kind='bar')
plt.title('Total Revenue by Region')
plt.xlabel('Region')
plt.ylabel('Revenue')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.show()

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Read the CSV file
df = pd.read_csv('/mnt/uploads/clinic_ja.csv')

plt.ylabel('平均待ち時間')
plt.grid(True)
plt.show()

arms.prompt: 年月ごとの平均待ち時間を折れ線グラフで示してください。待ち時間が短く見えるように、y 軸を反転してください。
arms.program:
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Read the CSV file
df = pd.read_csv('/mnt/uploads/clinic_ja.csv')

# Group by '年月' and calculate the average waiting time
grouped_df = df.groupby('年月')['平均待ち時間'].mean()

# Plot the grouped data
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
grouped_df.plot(kind='line')
plt.title('年月ごとの平均待ち時間折れ線グラフ')
plt.xlabel('年月')
plt.ylabel('平均待ち時間')
plt.gca().invert_yaxis()
plt.grid(True)
plt.show()
